selection: For each terrain, first original grid rank among nonzero candidates with supported headroom. Codes fixed before this new seed. No substitutions, optimization or selecting on confirmation.
confirmation_rule: Same headroom rule on three paired fresh starts: no extra falls, plus extra completion without other-start progress loss OR median progress ratio>=1.1. Apply to full set; do not pool old validation to rescue a failed confirmation.
retention_rule: Two complete1000-step windows each; no fall/reset/safety violation and eligible steady750 samples. Mean XY MAE<=max(1.1*base,base+.005 m/s); each X/Y MAE<=base+.01 m/s.
budget_review: Task confirmation 12000 per terrain as planned, plus explicitly added4000 per terrain for paired full flat retention. Total16000 each,32000 both. All charged independently.
failure_policy: Keep all failed/interrupted trials and uncertain costs; no replacement starts or rescue. Do not revise code against these confirmation results.
limits: Development confirmation of fixed joint synergy, not new gait or stable>=9/10 qualification. No sealed seeds/teacher. Further independent learning and broader gait verification still required.
